data.title: Ship as a pytest plugin with per-skill opt-in evals
data.description: pytest already owns discovery, selection and reporting, so the harness is a plugin

data.title: Every eval cell always invokes the real CLI
data.description: no replay tier and no --live flag; a cell that did not spawn an agent has measured nothing

data.title: RunResult is a stdlib dataclass serialised to JSON
data.description: a committed JSON Schema is the parity contract, so the plugin needs no validation library

data.title: A workspace is a plain copy of the fixture tree, with no git context
data.description: no git init and no worktree, so diff-reading skills stay out of scope until the seam is used

data.title: A private per-run CODEX_HOME, seeded with the credential files
data.description: isolating the whole state store makes log correlation structural instead of a race

data.title: A local prices.toml is authoritative, with an optional upstream seed
data.description: an upstream feed fills the table but is never the thing the harness reads

data.title: An unpriced model aborts at matrix expansion and never prices as zero
data.description: price coverage is checked before the first paid call, and the failure names the fix

data.title: Evals are `eval_*.py` modules collected by a directory-scoped hook
data.description: a scoped collect hook keeps paid cells away from an ordinary unit-test run

data.title: Register the plugin from the rootdir conftest.py
data.description: the rootdir conftest is the one place pytest honours `pytest_plugins` for an uninstalled package

data.title: Global default matrix, per-case override, and --model / --cli / --dry-run
data.description: the matrix is the spend dial, so it is exposed as options rather than hidden behind -k

data.title: The skill under test loads through each CLI's own skill path
data.description: the eval exercises skill loading, not skill text pasted into a prompt

data.title: Grading semantics are not prescribed; the plugin supplies primitives
data.description: case authors get composable primitives, and the only house rule is that no check passes silently

data.title: Custom verifiers are Python modules beside the case
data.description: import is the extension mechanism, so there is no registry, DSL or new file format

data.title: Register through the pytest11 entry point of an extracted package
data.description: installing the package is the whole registration, and every location becomes an ini key

data.title: Harness is the axis name, and the project owns the default matrix
data.description: one word for the first axis, and a project scope between the case and the plugin default

data.title: Results travel on the test report, and cells group by harness
data.description: user_properties is the one channel xdist serialises, so per-cell records ride on it

data.title: Distribute through PyPI with trusted publishing, released from a GitHub Release
data.description: one trigger and one OIDC identity, so no long-lived publishing token is stored or rotated

data.title: Fixtures live under evals/fixtures/, and every live cell appends to a metrics history
data.description: seed trees become a shared pool, and each paid cell appends one committed metrics line

data.title: Every run carries a per-call ledger; tokens are reported as context and billed; cache writes price by TTL
data.description: the per-call detail that explains every headline figure is kept rather than normalised away

data.title: `captured/report.html` is a static microsite over the captured JSON
data.description: a static page over relative-path JSON is the cheapest reader that survives the next run

data.title: Metric names carry their unit and their source; the report has a named vocabulary and addressable ids
data.description: a metric name is read without its definition beside it, so it must carry unit and source

data.title: A catalogued record kind per log line, and skill file coverage per run
data.description: colour the kind of information, and measure which skill files a run actually touched

data.title: A turn owns its tools' results; skills declare what is not decision surface; captures replay without spend
data.description: attribute evidence by cause, and never pay to recompute what is already on disk

data.title: Context window consumption and timing are first-class metrics; injected messages are not prompts; the report is themed by design tokens and can be written standalone
data.description: report what the provider measured, and qualify every percentage by its denominator

data.title: A result names the case that produced it, and the per-turn charts have a session-log-line axis
data.description: say which question produced the evidence, and draw a measurement where it was taken

data.title: What is not decision surface is declared in the project's pytest config, not in a dotfile beside the skill
data.description: a plugin's configuration lives where its host keeps configuration, not in a new dotfile

data.title: Skill coverage follows the shell's working directory
data.description: state a tool keeps between calls is part of every call's meaning, so the detector tracks cwd

data.title: The report page is built from a component workspace and shipped as one file
data.description: the build carries the dependencies so the wheel stays free of them

data.title: The billed sum is named `accumulative_billed_tokens`
data.description: name the aggregation as well as the unit, or the name will be read two ways

data.title: Project price rows live in the pytest config, not in a prices.toml beside it
data.description: the second config file has to argue harder than the first, and prices state the published unit

data.title: The report draws with Plotly on a Tamagui base, every state deeplinks, and a Playwright matrix sweeps them all
data.description: a quality bar over every permutation is only checkable if every state has a URL

data.title: All run output consolidates under `.xharness_eval_cache/`, and the report is one combine step
data.description: every writer owns a unique path and one combine step aggregates, as pytest-cov does

data.title: Subagent transcripts are captured evidence, and their tokens are billed
data.description: every thread the agent spawned is part of the run, so it is captured and billed

data.title: A harness is a class, the registry is the only dispatch, and the layers are named
data.description: give the axis a type, make the registry the only dispatch, and let a linter hold the boundary

data.title: The nouns carry their own invariants
data.description: put the sum on the type that owns it, so the illegal state stops being a reviewer's job

data.title: A folding constructor declares its keyword fields
data.description: a TypedDict unpacked into the call checks the keywords `**kwargs Any` had erased

data.title: The emitted records are types, and the cache tree has one owner
data.description: a document a program emits is part of its interface, so it gets a type and a pinned key set

data.title: A tolerant reader still honours its declaration
data.description: forgiving an unknown key but forwarding a null into a typed field only moves the failure

data.title: The package listing is the architecture
data.description: when the folders are the layers, "may this import that" has an answer a linter can check

data.title: The plugin is a hook manifest, and each job behind it is a module
data.description: push the expensive line down until the pragma fits it exactly, and test what is left

data.title: A shared vocabulary is a domain noun, and a manifest exports nothing of its own
data.description: a vocabulary belongs in the layer everyone may import, and it must type a field

data.title: The overview is filtered by the URL, and the summary aggregates the chart's own groups
data.description: two views of the same data on one page group it the same way, or they are not a pair

data.title: The overview's tables are budgeted to one screen, and the aggregate has a decomposition as well as an accumulation
data.description: a metric a reader cannot see is a metric that does not exist, so width is a contract

data.title: A skill is invoked the way its user invokes it, in each harness's own syntax
data.description: an eval that has to explain the harness to the agent is measuring the harness

data.title: The verifiers ship with the plugin, and a rollout has one documented surface
data.description: composable is a decision about the shape of grading, not a reason to ship no vocabulary

data.title: A golden is compared facet by facet, and every facet declares its tolerance
data.description: name the parts of the answer, and say for each how much variation is still correct

data.title: ADRs are authored as data, and the argument travels verbatim
data.description: the records become data, and the argument is carried as verbatim markdown block scalars

data.title: The record schema is the librarian's shipped one, adopted strictly
data.description: the corpus is re-authored into the strict shape rather than the schema loosened to fit it
